items.title: Europol Arrests 34 Black Axe Members in Spain Over €5.9M Fraud and Organized Crime
items.description: Europol on Friday announced the arrest of 34 individuals in Spain who are alleged to be part of an international criminal organization called Black Axe. As part of an operation conducted by the Spanish National Police, in coordination with the Bavarian State Criminal Police Office and Europol, 28 arrests were made in Seville, along with three others in Madrid, two in Málaga, and one in Barcelona

items.title: New MacSync Stealer Uses Signed macOS App to Evade Gatekeeper and Steal Data
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a new variant of the MacSync malware targeting macOS users. Unlike previous versions that relied on complex ClickFix techniques, this iteration masquerades as a legitimately signed, notarised Apple application, thereby bypassing macOS Gatekeeper security and stealing sensitive data.
